headline: As of 2026-09-23: 116,973 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 8 of 50 states, D+34.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 116,973 early/mail ballots cast so far across 8 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+34.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (94,284), Wisconsin (9,654), North Carolina (8,280).
